title: May Administration Portal — Implementation Specification
purpose: Defines the May Administration Portal — a role-based administrative experience for managing students, test results, content inventory, certification workflow, recommendation tracking, and modernization activities. Accessible via the May Administration Portal as a distinct frontend layer.

authentication.mechanism: Role-based access control (RBAC). Each role has defined access permissions. Higher roles inherit lower-role permissions.

Student.description: Default role for learners. Can take exams, review results, and see personalized study recommendations.

Content_Administrator.description: Manages content inventory. Can view all questions, search the registry, manage remediation queues, and edit unprocessed content.

Certification_Reviewer.description: Reviews and certifies content. Accesses certification board queues (READY, HOLD, ESCALATE, CERTIFIED). Performs CAQS 10-dimension review.

Governance_Administrator.description: Oversees governance operations. Manages governance guard rules, audit reports, registry integrity, and framework controls.

System_Administrator.description: Full platform administration. Manages users, roles, system configuration, and platform maintenance.

student_management.description: Manage students, enrollments, permissions, and progress tracking.

question_management.description: Search and manage the question inventory.
features: Search by defect class (DL-008, DL-026, etc.)
View question detail (Stem, Choices, CC, EC, EW, metadata)
question_management.data_source: CANONICAL_REGISTRY.json + pack files via AM-1 extraction

session_registry.description: Search and view sessions in the certification history.
features: Search by session ID (S200, S201, S809, S810, etc.)

certification_operations_console.description: The certification board interface — displays Framework v2 readiness queues.
features: READY queue: items that passed all pre-flight gates
MINOR_FIX queue: items with SOFT_BLOCK warnings
REMEDIATE queue: items requiring defect remediation
BLOCKED queue: items with structural impairments
CERTIFIED queue: items in the learner delivery pool
Queue filtering by pack, section, defect class, priority
certification_operations_console.data_source: CANONICAL_REGISTRY.json + readiness classification from Readiness Engine

features: Phase gate status (S830, S900, S910 readiness)
modernization_dashboard.data_source: CANONICAL_REGISTRY.json + DELTA_LEDGER.json + scan artifacts + throughput metrics

architecture_notes.frontend: The May Administration Portal is a separate frontend layer (admin.html) served alongside the student-facing index_updated.html. Shares the same data layer (pack files, registry files).
architecture_notes.data_layer: All admin modules query CANONICAL_REGISTRY.json, RECOMMENDATION_REGISTRY.json, NAVIGATION_REGISTRY.json, and DELTA_LEDGER.json. These are generated at session T0 by the respective engines.
architecture_notes.authentication_integration: Authentication is role-based with separate login for admin vs. student. Access tokens managed via app.js session mechanism.
architecture_notes.governance_hooks: Certification Operations Console writes to REVISION_HISTORY.md on state transitions. Governance guard Rules 1-10 are enforced at write time.
